question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Damper.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option is Damper.
 
• Damper means **a person or thing that has a depressing, subduing, or inhibiting effect.**
 
• Thus the appropriate option to fill in the blank is Damper.
